summary: Flat kerb under trees; car yards opposite, homes 15-20 m behind.

best_section.where: South kerb of Finney Road, under the big trees opposite the car yard

drivers.seclusion: Dense trees and a vacant bush strip behind; nearest dwellings about 15-20 m away, set back.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a through road; cars park along it, so a van fits at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Moderate through traffic; commercial car parks across the road, quiet at night.
drivers.convention: No signs here and a parked car at the west end; plain kerb, no overnight convention.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades the section from the south all day.
